neighbours.label: a condition or exception clause opened after a rule (prohibited ... if / except when / unless ...): its opener and first words
fire: Tenants may not sublet the apartment if such an arrangement breaches the lease.
The warranty is void except when the damage is caused by a factory defect.
Refunds will be refused if the receipt shows signs of alteration.
Drivers are fined unless the parking permit is clearly displayed.
Staff may not accept gifts if the value exceeds fifty dollars.
The contract terminates automatically if either party becomes insolvent.
Visitors are admitted free except when a special exhibition is running.
The price shall not change if delivery is delayed by the supplier.
quiet: Tenants may not sublet the apartment, and the lease lists other rules.
The warranty is void, and the damage report was filed yesterday.
Refunds will be refused, and the store manager will explain why.
Drivers are fined, and the parking office sends a letter.
Staff may not accept gifts, and the policy is posted online.
The contract runs for two years, and both parties signed it.
Visitors are admitted free, and the museum opens at nine.
The price shall stay fixed, and delivery is planned for May.

notes: card: ' if', ' when', ' that', 'если' after a rule statement; probe: peak lands on the noun right after 'if such'. Output promotes implies/resulting. Near misses keep the rule but join a plain coordinate clause.
